mas_codegen_ready.what: blocker vs warning audit; loop-depth tracking, not a regex grep

mas_codegen_verify.what: real codegen -> MSVC build -> both run -> compare, five stages reported

mas_fixpt_range.what: observed range + SQNR + overflow FRACTION; SKIP without Fixed-Point Designer

mas_ctrl_analyze.what: all 0dB/-180 crossings, unwrapped phase, worst margin not first

mas_ctrl_aw_sim.what: three anti-windup modes incl. back-calculation divided by Ki

mas_ctrl_pid_design.what: max bandwidth subject to a margin constraint; feasible=false when impossible

mas_table_audit.what: row ledger: balanced = nIn == nOut + nDropped, each row judged once

mas_route.what: weighted router; CLARIFY/AMBIGUOUS instead of guessing

mas_ekf_check.what: NEES/NIS consistency with a two-sided chi-square band

mas_frame_check.what: SE(3)/SO(3) hygiene; orthErr and det reported separately

mas_kin_check.what: planar n-R FK; analytic vs central-difference Jacobian element-wise

mas_kin_ik.what: DLS + step clamp + joint limits; reports raw and clamped step

mas_dep_probe.what: five-level dependency discovery, 8 named states, built-ins pinned

mas_precheck.what: 8 cheap checks; toolbox delegates to mas_dep_probe

mas_product_map.what: product<->license feature table incl. historical names

mas_toolbox_map.what: thin wrapper kept for backward compatibility

mas_image_metrics.what: IoU/Dice/P/R/F1 plus per-object matching by argmax over truth labels

mas_ofdm_ber.what: OFDM+QPSK chain vs erfc; per-point tolerance from counting noise

mas_spectrum_check.what: leakage, concentration, Parseval against the WINDOW-WEIGHTED power

mas_split_seed.what: reproducible stratified split with leak assertions

mas_bench_record.what: R1/R2/R3 ledger; SKIP can never become PASS, UNKNOWN never collapses to SKIP

mas_refcheck.what: freeze/verify with SHA-256; two tamper attacks caught

mas_verify_task.what: grades NUMBERS against the frozen manifest; never reads the task verdict

mas_capability_check.what: keeps the matrix honest: every mas_*.m must be listed, owners must match disk, summary counts must be derived, and every VERIFIED claim must cite a test file or a graded task id

mas_skill_graph.what: builds the skill call graph from routing.json + SKILL.md + cross-skill script calls; detects cycles, dangling routes, duplicate loading; the detector is pinned against 8 graphs with known answers

toolsNote: Generated from the files under skills/*/scripts. mas_capability_check.m fails when this drifts from disk, because a matrix that silently rots is worse than no matrix.
